title: ZEBRA!! — Cinematic Art Direction & Asset Sourcing
scope_notes: Research checked 2026-11-19; prices are listed offers, not guaranteed checkout prices. No purchases, downloads, actual import tests or visual performance benchmarks were performed. Vendor descriptions and rights are not independently audited. This is a revision/addendum to the existing resource bible: art direction and hero requirements override its low-poly and animal-placeholder recommendations; earlier audio, UI and reusable tool references remain candidates, subject to license and style checks. All new IDs AD-01 to AD-14 are additive.

art_direction.title: Art direction lock
art_direction.text: Stylized cinematic semi-realism. Stray is the reference for intimate, cluttered, lived-in alleys and animal-scale environmental storytelling; Cyberpunk 2077 for vertical megacity layers, signage, industrial scale and urban lighting. Neither game supplies assets or exact designs. The visual anchor remains IMG-01, not a mandate to reproduce copyrighted characters. Hoot is a human-bodied character with an owl head; Zebra! is a normal quadrupedal zebra. Both are custom hero assets, not low-poly replacements.

art_direction.title: Composition and density
art_direction.text: Build one playable street district with two narrow alleys, a wider chase artery, a utility tunnel and a rooftop vista. Use inaccessible upper floors, silhouettes, fog and skybox geometry to suggest a huge city. Spend detail where camera and gameplay dwell; do not build an open-world city.

art_direction.title: Surface language
art_direction.text: Physically based materials with visible wear at contact points: layered asphalt, chipped concrete, rust, wet metal, textured leather and restrained feathers. Use material variation and bevels rather than excessive geometry. Signs, pipes, ACs, wires, vents and litter create believable construction history. Avoid clean plastic toy surfaces, uniform chrome, overdone grunge and saturated neon on every surface.

art_direction.title: Color and light
art_direction.text: Continuum: charcoal #101820, slate #273237, green #28D887, teal #377B79; sparks/alarms #E97A36 and red #D62C41. Reserve warm amber #C59052 for inhabited spaces and the bar; off-white #DDD5C6 highlights faces. Introduce emerald code mainly at facades, skyline and transitions. Keep faces, zebra stripes and routes visible under neutral key light.

art_direction.title: Camera and animation
art_direction.text: Third-person lower, behind-and-offset camera in alleys; wider chase framing for hoof placement, obstacles and rider. Use deliberate cinematic closeups for jokes, strong silhouette language and short slow-motion inserts; no constant depth of field or motion blur during interactive play. Keep cinematic comedy earnest, not cartoon slapstick.

art_direction.title: Design ownership
art_direction.text: Use original robot faceplates, silhouettes, lettering, symbols and fictional ads. Avoid recognizable Terminator endoskeleton copies, Matrix logo/code, actor likenesses, Stray/Cyberpunk models or extracted game content. Treat supplied concept images as internal visual references unless rights for public display are established.

assets.title: The Hidden Alley
assets.proposed_use: Primary Stray-style street dressing: 39 collection entries, including urban facades, fire escapes, security cameras, utility boxes, street lamps, fences and rubbish.
assets.integration_and_risks: Use source assets individually; rebuild lighting and collisions. Check texture resolution and simplify photogrammetric geometry where necessary. Do not import the entire showcase as a level.

assets.title: Cyberpunk - Asset Pack
assets.license: Extended Commercial License listed at ArtStation; no standalone resale
assets.proposed_use: Best first paid candidate: five building styles, street kit, neon billboards, Chinatown, shops, props and assembled city. Painted mid-poly PBR geometry is an appropriate starting point for the broad city.
assets.integration_and_risks: Use Blender to extract modular meshes; inspect pivots, UVs, LODs, textures and scale. Texture downloads are several GB. Replace signs with original designs. Confirm purchased license and AI permissions before supplying assets to AI services. Alternative itch listing 19.99 EUR.

assets.title: Industrial Facility Environment
assets.license: Commercial game-use terms not explicit in retrieved listing; confirm before purchase/production
assets.proposed_use: Realistic factory, service tunnels and processing tower: 60+ meshes including walls, roofs, pipelines, stairs, electrical gear and workplace props.
assets.integration_and_risks: Preferred over sci-fi station if visual preview and license pass. Confirm PBR texture files are available outside the Unreal archive; test 2-3 modules in Godot. Publisher labels no generative AI.

assets.title: Industrial Sci-Fi Station
assets.license: Seller states personal/commercial project use; no raw redistribution
assets.proposed_use: 59 modular pieces on a 2 m grid: corridors, cryo pods, doors, grating, catwalks, pipes, server racks and machinery. Low-cost alternative or complement to AD-03.
assets.integration_and_risks: Download free sample first. Seller discloses AI-assisted graphics. Verify topology, repeatable snapping, material consistency, rights and source license before purchase.

assets.title: Robot Crew - 7 Characters
assets.license: Commercial project license stated; no reselling/sharing files
assets.formats: GLB / FBX; 2K PBR; 7 clips per robot
assets.proposed_use: Common robot silhouettes for security, workers, combat and service robots; shared 24-bone humanoid naming. Seven advertised animation clips from idle to death.
assets.integration_and_risks: AI-assisted Meshy generation disclosed; seller describes provenance CSV. Inspect rig quality, facial/eye design, animation and metallic material before accepting. Not a guaranteed film-like endoskeleton or Kevin final design; custom armor and red eyes may be needed.

assets.title: Cyberpunk Alley & Neon Street - 25 Props
assets.license: Fab Standard (verify actual tier on checkout; same scope of rights under EULA)
assets.proposed_use: Neon tubes, signage, fuse boxes, drains, cables, posters and small urban details. Potential supplement if core assets leave holes.
assets.integration_and_risks: No LODs or collision listed. Do not buy before AD-01/02 are evaluated. Check AI-use metadata; keep purchased assets private.

assets.title: Poly Haven model library
assets.proposed_use: Search exact catalog titles: Round Spectacles, Wine Bottles 01, Decorative Book Set 01, Fancy Picture Frame 02, Modular Industrial Pipes 01, Metal Office Desk, Modular Factory Facade, Old Drill Press, Wooden Display Shelves 01.
assets.integration_and_risks: Props are not hero-character meshes. Rebuild glasses fit and glass/liquid shader independently. Use 1K/2K for background items; retain high detail for closeups.

assets.title: ambientCG PBR materials
assets.proposed_use: Asphalt, brick, weathered concrete, steel, leather and floor tiles. Build reusable dry/damp/wet material variants and consistent surface scale.
assets.integration_and_risks: Use OpenGL normal maps, linear packed data maps and sRGB base color. Do not turn the road into a perfect mirror; use a puddle mask.

assets.title: The Shed collection
assets.proposed_use: Warm real-world workshop and bar dressing; furniture, tools, plants, storage and signs of human activity.
assets.integration_and_risks: Download relevant models only; original story-specific props remain custom. Find The Shed on collections page.

assets.title: Blueprint / Hologram shader
assets.license: CC0 code; preview images/assets not covered
assets.proposed_use: Starting point for translucent scanline holograms and flickering Curator projections.
assets.integration_and_risks: Review code, tune scanlines and opacity, test sorting and performance. Use original glyphs, faces and artwork. Reimplement code if needed.

assets.title: Mixamo
assets.license: Royalty-free use of characters and animations in games per FAQ; do not distribute raw animations separately
assets.proposed_use: Hoot humanoid body locomotion and gestures; potential retargeting to robot skeleton.
assets.integration_and_risks: Not suitable for quadrupedal Zebra auto-rigging; custom facial/coat and riding animation. Avoid raw assets as AI inputs without permission.

assets.title: Tripo Studio
assets.listed_price: Free prototype tier; paid private generation recommended; pricing varies
assets.license: Conflicting official free-plan statements; pricing and commercial-rights help state noncommercial/no commercial grant, while product docs mention attribution
assets.formats: Generated meshes, textures, rigs; verify selected export
assets.proposed_use: Potential custom Hoot/Zebra mesh starting point, original robot/drone or prop generation.
assets.integration_and_risks: Do not ship free-tier output until written rights clarification. Generate private on eligible paid plan for release if terms permit; save generation IDs, terms and receipts. Retopologize, rig and animate in Blender. Do not upload third-party models without permission.

assets.title: Meridian-9 Cyberpunk City
assets.license: Confirm exact license in archive/listing before use
assets.formats: GLB / FBX / BLEND; PBR and emission
assets.proposed_use: Budget backup for distant skyline or blockout; vendor claims 356 assets and 91 animated models.
assets.integration_and_risks: Low-poly and AI-assisted; not the primary semi-realistic street look. Sale may expire. Verify licensing and quality; avoid buying just for asset count.

assets.title: Sci-Fi Modular Power Cores & Cyber Relics
assets.license: Seller states commercial use; license text in download
assets.proposed_use: Seven optional close-up props: power cells, hologram projector, quantum cartridge.
assets.integration_and_risks: AI-assisted provenance disclosed; inspect downloaded license and topology. Do not use as an excuse to overcomplicate the final blank-paper room.

scene_map.title: Rocket cold open
scene_map.design: Custom retro red/silver rocket; space backdrop and dramatic cape silhouette. Stage as 60-90 second on-rails opening; reuse prior AS-019/020/025 only if style and license pass.

scene_map.title: An ordinary Tuesday / final cinema
scene_map.design: Small apartment / cinema lobby from a believable urban shell; weathered books, shelves, signs, CRT and amber lighting. Build one accessible room, not full building interiors.

scene_map.title: Zebra chase
scene_map.design: Flagship chase: modular city facades, cluttered side alleys, green-lit boulevard, rain, wet asphalt, robots, drones, original motorcycles and holographic billboards. Reuse the same block with alternate camera angles.

scene_map.title: Kevin / Museum of Everything
scene_map.design: Service tunnel and museum gallery reuse wall modules; add classical frames, benches and original displayed art. Kevin requires a distinct custom or modified robot with red eye lights and readable gestures.

scene_map.title: Factory / Garden of Unfinished Things
scene_map.design: Factory catwalks, machinery, pipes and panels; contrasting warm workshop built with wood, hand tools and foliage. Use one traversal/puzzle route.

scene_map.title: Origin / Curator offer
scene_map.design: Curator room: restrained library/lounge dressing, original display faces and holograms; use material/lighting swaps rather than building a second city.

scene_map.title: Final Draft assault / rescue
scene_map.design: Reuse chase blocks and factory kit as tower approach, bridges and core corridors; add staged destruction, sparks, drones, original robots. Avoid physics destruction of entire buildings.

scene_map.title: Last Original Thought / final confrontation
scene_map.design: One quiet core room with custom blank paper, pencil and simple wooden table. Lighting and sound sell the contrast, not more assets.

scene_map.title: Epilogue / rocket / post-credits
scene_map.design: Reuse street module for bar exterior and warm apartment furniture for the Rusty Horseshoe; return to rocket cinematic. Custom terrible zebra drawing as narrative prop.

technical_guidance.title: Renderer
technical_guidance.text: Desktop Godot 4.x Forward+; pin actual stable version at project start. 1080p/60 fps is an acceptance target, not an achieved benchmark. Use SSR only as a complement to reflection probes: screen-space reflections cannot see offscreen objects. Enable SSAO, carefully limited volumetric fog and HDR glow; use local lights to fake bounce if required. Tone mapping and exposure should be tested on both protagonists.

technical_guidance.title: Materials
technical_guidance.text: Godot glTF 2.0 preferred; convert Blender/FBX sources to GLB with baked textures. Assign OpenGL +Y normals; preserve UV scale, metallic/roughness and AO. Use external material overrides and wrapper scenes so reimport is nondestructive. Wetness mask blends roughness (dry ~0.65-0.9, puddles ~0.08-0.25, artistic starting ranges), darkens asphalt and retains normal detail. Use opaque wet road material instead of stacked transparent planes.

technical_guidance.title: Lighting and effects
technical_guidance.text: Use 1-2 shadowed hero lights per street segment as a starting budget; most fixtures use emissive materials and unshadowed local lights. Bake static lighting where appropriate; select one primary GI strategy after profiling. Particle-based rain and smoke, scripted puddle ripples, recycled sparks/explosions. Digital code on emissive facade strips and SubViewport billboards, with original type and glyphs. Avoid full-screen distracting flashes; add reduced flash/shake settings.

technical_guidance.title: Geometry and performance
technical_guidance.text: Use modular snap grids per kit; unify scale at 1 unit = 1 m. Build low-complexity colliders and navigation independently. Suggested starting budgets, not hard limits: 50-90k triangles Hoot, 35-70k Zebra, 15-35k close robots, 1-10k street props; distant variants much lower. 2K textures for most near assets, 1K for props, selective 4K hero textures. Use visibility ranges, LODs, occlusion and instancing for recurring props. Profile actual CPU/GPU frametimes and VRAM at 1080p; set fallback for fog/SSR/shadows.

technical_guidance.title: Hero pipeline
technical_guidance.text: Custom meshes from Blender and optional Tripo, then topology, UVs, textures, skeletons, weights and LODs. Hoot uses human skeleton and owl head, independent eye/beak shape keys/rig, coat bones or baked secondary motion, hand/beak sockets. Zebra uses equine rig; no humanoid retarget for quadruped. Make separate gait clips; sync riding root and gait phase with saddle socket and feet/reins IK. Keep mount animation and drinking upper-body layer independent. Test walk/trot/canter/gallop, turning, stops, mount and dismount.

technical_guidance.title: Asset intake
technical_guidance.text: Use raw vendor archive outside runtime; license copy and provenance ledger, hash and derived paths. Import 2-3 pieces in a sandbox project before buying additional kits. Verify scale/pivots, mesh topology, material maps, collision, animated skeleton, LODs and clarity in rain. Restrict paid files to licensed collaborators and avoid public repos. Do not feed Unity store files or NoAI-tagged products into AI tools; check exact contract even for itch/ArtStation. Codex can operate on original code and metadata without ingesting restricted asset bytes.

production_gates.title: Gate 1 — look development
production_gates.text: Create one 30-50 m alley with free AD-01/08 assets, simple wet asphalt, code billboard, rain and one moving light. Put greyboxed Hoot/Zebra at camera scale. Capture street-height and chase-camera screenshots; accept only if lighting reveals character silhouettes.

production_gates.title: Gate 2 — first purchase
production_gates.text: If alley look passes, evaluate DEEZL AD-02 as city kit. Confirm license, download, convert and test three facades plus signs. A single city shell must support both intimate and broad chase framing. Spend $19.99 only after preview check.

production_gates.title: Gate 3 — vertical slice
production_gates.text: Block 3-5 minutes: alley start, street chase, obstacle jump, drone flyby, robot ambush, slow-motion wine spill and tunnel exit. Test Hoot/Zebra rigs at gait transitions with gameplay camera; use simple stand-ins until rigs are finished.

production_gates.title: Gate 4 — expand
production_gates.text: Only after vertical slice runs acceptably, evaluate AD-04 free sample or AD-03 industrial kit, and AD-05 robots. Reuse city geometry for assault and final scenes. Add original character-specific art, audio and environmental storytelling; do not buy multiple redundant city packs.
